objective: Smoke test: add unit tests for the slugify() and truncate() helpers in orchestrator/util.mjs, in a new file orchestrator/test/util.test.mjs using node:test. Do not modify util.mjs or any other file. The test command is: npm test
risks: Encoding wishful behavior instead of real behavior — especially slugify's trim-before-slice trailing dash and truncate's exact suffix wording; every assertion must be derived from orchestrator/util.mjs:60-78, not from intuition.
Temptation to 'fix' util.mjs quirks (NaN char count when max is omitted, slugify throwing on undefined). Out of scope and would break the strictly-additive constraint.
Non-ASCII assertions can look surprising ("café" -> "caf"); an author may mis-assert "cafe" and cause a red suite.
File placed outside orchestrator/test/ or named without the .test.mjs suffix would silently not run while still appearing to pass.
Very low blast radius otherwise: pure functions, no I/O, no shared state.
recommendation: Merge the feature branch after a human glance.
